aqiAdvisory.good: Air is clean — no precautions needed.
aqiAdvisory.satisfactory: Minor discomfort possible for very sensitive people.
aqiAdvisory.moderate: People with asthma or heart conditions should limit long exposure.
aqiAdvisory.poor: Breathing discomfort likely for most people. Wear a mask outdoors.
aqiAdvisory.veryPoor: Avoid outdoor exertion. Keep windows shut.
aqiAdvisory.severe: Health emergency. Stay indoors if you can.

alert.derivedNote: Derived by MAUSAM from the live forecast — not an official IMD warning.
alert.allClear: Nothing needs your attention right now.
alert.allClearBody: We are watching rainfall, heat, air quality, wind, fog and sea conditions for this location. You will see an alert here the moment any of them crosses a threshold.

rainExtreme.why: Above 204 mm in a day. Flooding and waterlogging are likely and some roads may close.
rainExtreme.action: Do not travel unless you must. Move vehicles off low ground, and keep a charged phone and a torch within reach.

rainVeryHeavy.why: 115–204 mm in a day. Expect waterlogging on low roads and long traffic delays.
rainVeryHeavy.action: Avoid underpasses and low-lying routes. Leave early, or postpone trips that can wait.

rainHeavy.why: 64–115 mm in a day, heaviest around {peak}. Local waterlogging is likely.
rainHeavy.action: Allow 20–30 extra minutes and stay out of underpasses around {peak}.

rainModerate.why: Enough to slow traffic and soak anyone caught outside, heaviest around {peak}.
rainModerate.action: Carry a raincoat and plan outdoor work around {peak}.

storm.why: Lightning is the hazard, not the rain. Open ground, terraces and tall trees are the dangerous places.
storm.action: Get indoors before it arrives. Stay off terraces and unplug sensitive electronics.

heatSevere.why: At this level heatstroke can develop within an hour of exertion outdoors.
heatSevere.action: Stay indoors between 12:00 and 16:00. Drink water every 20 minutes and add ORS or salted lemon water.

heatHigh.why: Sustained outdoor effort becomes risky, especially without shade.
heatHigh.action: Shift outdoor work to before 10:00 or after 17:00 and keep water within reach.

heatElevated.why: Humidity is holding the apparent temperature above the actual one.
heatElevated.action: Take a shaded break every 30 minutes if you are working outside.

aqiSevere.why: CPCB Severe. Healthy people feel it too, and existing heart or lung conditions worsen.

aqiVeryPoor.why: CPCB Very Poor. Breathing discomfort is likely for most people on prolonged exposure.

aqiPoor.why: CPCB Poor. Discomfort on prolonged exposure, and sooner if you have asthma.

aqiAction.ozone: {pollutant} is the main pollutant, so a mask will not help. Keep outdoor activity to before 10:00 or after 18:00.
aqiAction.particulate: {pollutant} is the main pollutant. Wear an N95 outdoors, keep windows shut, and run a purifier if you have one.
aqiAction.other: {pollutant} is the main pollutant. Cut back outdoor exertion and keep windows shut during traffic hours.

windGale.why: Strong enough to bring down branches, hoardings and loose sheeting.
windGale.action: Stay clear of hoardings and trees. Two-wheelers should avoid flyovers and open stretches.

windSquall.why: Gusts at this strength destabilise two-wheelers and blow over light structures.
windSquall.action: Secure loose items on balconies and terraces, and ride slowly on exposed roads.

fogDense.why: Below 1 km, stopping distance is longer than what you can see ahead.
fogDense.action: Use low beam and fog lamps, never high beam, and double your following distance.

fog.why: Visibility drops fastest in the hour before sunrise.
fog.action: Add 10–15 minutes to your commute and keep hazard lights ready.

uvExtreme.why: Unprotected skin can burn in under 15 minutes.
uvExtreme.action: SPF 50+, reapplied every two hours. Stay in shade between 11:00 and 16:00.

uvHigh.why: Burning is likely after about an hour of unshaded exposure.
uvHigh.action: SPF 30+, sunglasses and a hat, and prefer shade around midday.

frost.why: At this temperature frost can settle on exposed soil and damage young plants.
frost.action: Water lightly in the evening and cover seedlings overnight — wet soil holds heat better.

waveHigh.why: {seaState} sea with strong currents. Unsafe even for experienced swimmers.
waveHigh.action: Stay out of the water and off rocks and breakwaters.

waveRough.action: Avoid swimming and keep children well back from the waterline.

waveModerate.why: {seaState} sea — fine for a walk, rough for swimming.
waveModerate.action: Swim only in patrolled areas and stay within your depth.

schoolRain.why: A {rain}% chance of rain across the {window} window.
schoolRain.action: Send a raincoat rather than an umbrella, and allow extra time at pickup.

sowing.why: Soil moisture is {moisture}% with only a {rain}% chance of rain — the ground is workable.
sowing.action: A good window for sowing or transplanting. Nothing else needed.
